name: Default
finalized: 2026-11-27: good/bad variant A (cerulean / vermilion); brand colours are kept and warned about, never replaced

changelog.1.5.0: Map tokens: classed sequential ramps for 3 to 7 classes and diverging ramps for 4 to 7 classes, sampled from the existing ramps (data.<mode>.sequentialClasses, divergingClasses), a diverging neutral that stays clear of land (divergingNeutral), a crosshatched no-data pattern on land, the region stroke, the hover halo and outline, the inset frame and the small-region leader labels (map).
changelog.1.4.0: Block height presets: compact, default and tall, each with desktop and phone values for the chart plot, the KPI figure and sparkline, and the rows a scrolling table shows. default matches the heights of 1.3.0.
changelog.1.3.0: Series groups: the lead step of each family may differ from the family's base slot so that steps 2 and 3 always recede behind it; checks.<mode>.groupCVD.leadVsBase records how far each lead is from its base slot. All group bars still hold: every step is at least 3:1 on the page (light) and cardAlt (dark), every pair of steps in a family is at least ΔE2000 10, and every step is at least 8 from the other families, the ungrouped slots outside its family and the context grey, under normal vision and the three Machado simulations. Categorical slots, good and bad are unchanged.
changelog.1.2.0: Series groups: three hue families (blue on slots 1 and 5, pink and red on slots 2, 6 and 8, green on slot 4) with three lightness steps each, in light and dark, as stroke and fill. Step 1 is the family's base slot colour. Every step is at least 3:1 on the page (light) and cardAlt (dark); every pair of steps in a family is at least ΔE2000 10, and every step is at least 8 from the other families, the ungrouped slots outside its family and the context grey, under normal vision and the three Machado simulations. Lightness only, no dash. Categorical slots, good and bad are unchanged.
changelog.1.1.0: Categorical palette adapted from the FT's g-chartcolour 0.8.26 (BSD-3-Clause), with separate stroke and fill sets. Strokes (lines, points, line keys) use data.<mode>.categorical, built from FT categorical_line; fills (bars, areas, pie and donut slices, square keys) use data.<mode>.categoricalFill, built from FT categorical_bar and re-ordered so slot n matches the stroke hue of slot n. Light values keep FT's hues, with lightness adjusted where a slot missed 3:1 contrast or the colour-vision separation bar; the dark set is derived. Context grey unchanged.
changelog.1.0.1: Names are never middle-truncated (legends, keys and direct labels reflow, bar categories wrap), KPI sparklines get the line tooltip, KPI note to sparkline gap 8 to 12 px.

origin: Designed for Hatchmark. Categorical colours are adapted from the FT's g-chartcolour 0.8.26 (BSD-3-Clause).

layers.brand: overridable through brand-layer.schema.json; see brandable flags

caption.use: ticks, axis labels, legends, captions, table headers, annotation notes

body.use: table cells, bar list, tooltip rows, card subtitles

type.truncation: names are never cut in the middle. Series names (legend, key, direct labels, readout) reflow, and only a name wider than the whole card ends in an ellipsis; horizontal bar categories wrap to tableMaxLines in a column up to 40% of the chart; vertical bar ticks thin, then end in an ellipsis. The full name is always in the tooltip.

rules.moreThan6: group into Other or small multiples (check error HM-C006)
rules.strokeAndFill: categorical paints strokes: lines, points, line legend keys and series-coloured text. categoricalFill paints fills: bars, stacked and 100% segments, areas, pie and donut slices and square legend keys. Slot n is the same hue family in both sets, so a series keeps its colour across chart types.
rules.order: fixed slot order c1..c8: categorical follows FT categorical_line order; categoricalFill takes, for each line slot, FT's categorical_bar colour of the nearest hue (bar indices 1,5,2,7,3,4,6,8). Series wrap after c8.
rules.highlightOne: c1 for the highlighted item, context for the rest

data.attribution: Categorical colours are adapted from the FT's g-chartcolour.

blockHeight.use: height: compact | default | tall on a block. chart: plot height of line, area, vertical bar, pie, donut and scatter charts (a longer key or more bars adds to it). pie: the largest pie or donut diameter. kpiSize, kpiLineHeight, sparkline: the KPI figure and its sparkline. tableRows: body rows a scrolling table shows before it scrolls. barRow, barRowMax: the shortest and tallest row of a horizontal bar chart. desktop applies from 600 px, phone below.

group.use: related cards share one container: 1px internal dividers in border colour, no gap, outer radius card

border.shadows: none on cards; one shadow on floating layers only (tooltip): 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08) light, none in dark

axis.xLabels: month starts, January and first label carry the year

directLabels.maxWidth: none: the full name and last value

annotations.band: notes above plot, max 2 rows, flip left at right edge, else numbered markers listed below

tooltip.mobile: pinned readout row above the plot instead of a floating card

legend.names: never truncated: the key drops to fewer columns or gives each label the width it needs

deltas.lowerIsBetter: flip colour, say lower is better
deltas.semantic: good and bad are judgement colours: never used for series, ramps or the accent

periodLegend.current: solid c1 line swatch 12x2 + date range
periodLegend.previous: dashed (3 2) c1 at the same width + date range

empty.undefined: — (em dash) in textSubtle with a one-line reason
empty.zero: a real 0 in the normal format
empty.noData: keep axes and baseline, no series, note in the plot centre: No <measure> in this period
empty.never: NaN, Infinity, skeleton shimmer, fake placeholder data

region.use: line and area charts only: the partial bucket's slot, behind grid-level content and in front of the card
region.extent: last bucket: from the midpoint between the previous point and the partial point to the plot's right edge; clipped first bucket: from the plot's left edge to the midpoint after the first point

line.note: the segment into the partial bucket stays solid; the region and the point carry the signal

point.note: drawn on every partial point (last, and first under clip), not only on hover

area.stacked: each band's partial slice is hatched in its own colour, no flat fill

bar.stacked: every stack part gets tint, hatch and outline in its own colour; parts under 6 px keep tint and outline and drop the hatch
bar.valueLabel: if a value label is shown on the partial bar, use textMuted

swatch.use: tooltip status line, tooltip series rows and the mobile readout when the bucket is partial

tooltip.layout: two lines above the series rows: (1) period label, caption 500, text; (2) hatched swatch (textSubtle) + status, caption 400, textMuted. Series rows use the hatched series swatch instead of the 10x2 line swatch. Total row as usual.
tooltip.mobile: the pinned readout row uses the same two lines, then the series values

choropleth.legend: threshold boxes with boundary labels and unit

symbols.labels: top 5 (desktop) or 3 (mobile), name + value, collision avoidance: right, left, upper-right, upper-left, above, below, else skip

projection.world: Equal Earth, cropped to data extent (lat -50..72)

hover.order: halo first, then outline, both centred on the region edge and drawn above every region
hover.barList: the matching row gets the same 1.5 px text-colour outline on its bar (inset 0.75) and its label in weight 500
